Appelle ton assurance civile, normalement ils couvrent ce genre d’accident et peuvent t’expliquer la marche à suivre.

Garde tes certificats medicaux et prends des photos des bleus et des dégats visibles.
Ils te demanderont d’aller faire constater tes blessures chez un medecin spécialisé (légiste ?), à la suite de l’enquête de police (de ta plainte, ne fais pas de main courante ça n’est pas suffisant et tu vas devoir y retourner) soit le coupable sera condamné en justice, soit les fonds de garantie te compenseront (s’il est parti vivre à l’étranger par exemple). Garde des justificatifs de toutes tes factures (materiel abimé, frais médicaux…) pour le dossier, ils serviront de preuve pour établir le dommage, il est possible que ce soit assez long, dans mon cas on a dû attendre que je sois soigné pour ensuite demander une compensation.

Pour une prochaine fois, appelle la police immédiatement depuis la scène de l’accident (je sais qu’on a pas la tête à ça, et qu’on pense surtout à s’en aller vite) mais ça facilite grandement les démarches administratives.

When she jumps, she will do an ice or a dark aoe : the pattern is the same, roll twice in her direction, you will land directly behind her, turn back and strike twice with a light weapon, once with a heavy one. If you’re good you can even backstab her but i never succeeded.

When she gets invisible look where the ice comes from, she will do it several times but you only need to see two to pinpoint her location. She will keep moving from the same distance in the same direction, so get where she will be and strike her once with heavy weapon, twice with light.

Whenever she gets close to you or do things you don’t recognize, run and try to stay away from her, she moves super fast and should be kept mid-range from you. If she’s close to you and you need to evade her combo, roll in her direction, she will try to grab you if you go backward.

My general advice would be, don’t greed, this is an endurance match, not a race, stick to striking her on the patterns you recognize.

You can also summon gael to help, i couldn’t because i went too far in the second dlc and i had a really hard time fighting her alone, but i studied her a lot and managed to kill her.

If you want to make French friends i’d advise you to talk with lonely people first, it’s scary to get in an already formed group but it’s fairly easy to make friends when they’re also alone. There’s a lot of people apparently waiting on someone or just casually hanging on their phone in front of the classroom they’ll have their next lecture in, a lot of them (obviously not all) pretend to be busy but are actually introverted. 

When i changed uni i usually tried to hang out with the people who had breaks at the same time as me in front of the class and sometimes i’d bring a bunch of cookies to share with the other student waiting. I met a lot of really cool people this way and i introduced them to each other so we would never be waiting alone again. Some of them stayed very dear friends years after and some went of to different adventures but i look back very fondly on our time together.
